description: The 'deprecated_code_envs' dataset provides comprehensive information about code environments that are no longer actively maintained or used. This dataset is particularly useful for IT administrators and data scientists who need to manage and audit code environments within an organization. It includes details such as the name and programming language of the environment, deployment mode, and the owner responsible for the environment. Additionally, it provides technical specifications like the Python interpreter version, core packages set, and the file path where the environment is stored. The dataset also tracks the size of the environment in megabytes, the projects where the environment is used, and the total number of instances of the environment. A URL is provided for direct access to the environment. This dataset is valuable for understanding the legacy systems in place, planning migrations, and ensuring compliance with software management policies. It helps in identifying which environments can be decommissioned or need updates, thereby optimizing resource usage and maintaining system efficiency.
shortDesc: Dataset of deprecated code environments with details on usage and configuration.

columns.name: code_env_name
columns.comment: Name of the code environment, identifies environment.

columns.name: code_env_lang
columns.comment: Programming language used in the environment, e.g., Python, R.

columns.name: deployment_mode
columns.comment: Mode of deployment, e.g., DESIGN_MANAGED, DSS_INTERNAL.

columns.name: owner
columns.comment: Email of the environment owner, identifies responsible person.

columns.name: python_interpreter
columns.comment: Version of Python interpreter used, e.g., PYTHON36.

columns.name: core_packages_set
columns.comment: Set of core packages, e.g., PANDAS10, AUTO.

columns.name: path
columns.comment: File path to the code environment, storage location.

columns.name: size_in_MB
columns.comment: Size of the code environment in megabytes.

columns.name: projectKeys_where_code_env_used
columns.comment: Projects where the code environment is used.

columns.name: total_instances_of_code_env
columns.comment: Total number of instances of the code environment.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL to access the code environment, direct link.
